name: k-pi-agent
author: K pi agent contributors
description: Standalone Windows desktop distribution for @agegr/pi-web (K pi agent)

scripts.pack:dir: npm run prepare:payload && npm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win --dir
scripts.dist:portable: npm run prepare:payload && npm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win portable
scripts.dist:installer: npm run prepare:payload && npm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win nsis
scripts.dist:all: npm run prepare:payload && npm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win portable nsis
